import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**Doctor check `instructions.bundle_size`** (deep-only, `src/sase/doctor/checks_instructions_bundle_size.py`)
- It runs for every enabled project and every provider whose root slot has a byte cap with explicit delivery on (Codex at 32 KiB and Grok at 120 KiB today). For each pair it compiles the root bundle the way a launch does, from the project's main checkout and your real home memory.
- **ERROR:** the bundle is still over the cap after compaction, so that launch falls back to native instructions.
- **WARN:** the bundle fits only after compaction (it names the step and the uncompacted size), or it failed to render.
- **OK:** everything fits; the summary shows the bundle closest to its cap.
- Projects are labeled by name, not directory key.
- Run live here, it reports WARN for one bundle: bob-cli on Codex fits only after compaction, 30,392 of 32,768 bytes, down from 36,425. All other projects fit both caps.
- It takes about 4.5 s cold and 1.2 s warm, so I made it deep-only.

- I added it to the always-run contract test set and raised that set's entry budget from 89 to 90 in `tests/test_contract_manifest.py`. Without this, an edit that only touches `sase/memory/*.md` runs only the contract set, so growth there would never reach the test. It adds about 0.9 s.

**Docs:** the instruction-bundle reference and internals pages now describe the size caps and compaction. I also updated the Codex provider page's 32 KiB text and added the new check to the doctor check list in `agent-clis.md`.

**Before-measurement** (read-only, recorded on the bead and on sase-1tz.3 along with the command to repeat after install): Codex fell back to native instructions for being oversize 212 times on athena and 230 times on apollo between Nov 13 and Nov 20.
